# Skyrail · 天轨

> Self-hosted, browser-streamed Computer Use powered by local Codex on your own Mac.

Skyrail runs the Codex runtime and native Mac control service locally. A desktop or phone browser receives live app/desktop views, continues Codex sessions, exchanges files and lets the owner take over. It is for users building their own Dot / Grok bot / Hark-style experience with local Codex. These names describe experience inspirations, not official integrations or complete feature parity.

Skyrail 是基于本地 Codex 的浏览器流式 Computer Use 工作台：在自己的 Mac 上部署，通过电脑或手机浏览器查看实时画面、继续会话、传递文件并人工接管，搭建自己的 Dot / Grok bot / Hark 风格体验。

## Product concepts

- Local Codex Computer Use / 本地 Codex 电脑操作
- Browser-streamed Computer Use / 浏览器流式电脑操作
- Self-hosted AI computer assistant / 自托管 AI 电脑助手
- Live Mac app streaming / Mac 应用实时画面串流
- Human takeover / 人工接管
- Desktop and mobile browser access / 电脑与手机浏览器访问

## Technical meaning

Local describes the runtime, control components and web service. Model calls use the owner's Codex account and configured service; it is not a claim of offline inference. Continuous viewing is separate from on-demand model observations. The model operates selected apps through Skyrail's native adapter; manual whole-desktop control uses macOS Screen Sharing/noVNC. Remote browser access uses an authenticated gateway and an operator-configured HTTPS tunnel.
